custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in at the test location as user B, whose role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' but neither 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' nor See Financial Data.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location with vendor A as its Vendor.
  • Start in both browsers on the Inventory page, on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C540881-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C540881-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • To create a custom role: Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type the Role Name; switch on Parts Department, then tick the boxes the setup names on its three rows, Part sales, Part Library and Inventory, and Vendor and order management (each has View, Create & Edit and Delete); See Financial Data is under Cross-Cutting Toggles; then click Create. (The setup above writes these boxes as, for example, Part Library & Inventory — View, which is the View box on the Part Library and Inventory row.)
  • User B: the QA site's sign-in screen offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B for this test. Signed in as Admin: Settings, then Staff in the left menu; click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick role B under Role and click Save & Close. Then, in the second (private) window, choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way, because other testers use that sign-in.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window shows a Vendor field, after Part Number.

Step 2:

  • The window closes.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 4:

  • Edit Inventory Part shows the Vendor field, holding vendor A.

Step 5:

  • The window closes.

Step 6:

  • User B also sees the Vendor field in New Inventory Part, after Part Number.

Step 7:

  • The window closes.

Step 8:

  • Part A is listed in browser 2.

Step 9:

  • User B sees the Vendor field holding vendor A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R4a: “Vendor always shows. Cost, Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge show only to a user who can see financial data. Min and Max show only while tracking is on (S4-R5).”
  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 9 Oct 2026, answer 6: “B) None. Vendor always shows. Only the Inventory list opens this window, and it never hides Vendor. S13-R4a updated.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10826, acceptance criteria: “Given any screen that opens the part dialog, when it opens, then the Vendor field shows.”
